title: Land a durable cross-model reconciliation record and ownership map; recommend Alternative A (canonical main owns; WP mechanisms ported as enhancement PRs); execute no convergence

roles.founder_intent_steward: The 2026-08-22 directive asks for organization around existing work, canonical ownership, no duplication, evidence strengthening, and a durable trail. The intent is preservation-first (INTENT-0021): nothing deleted, dispositions recommended not executed. Recording this directive as INTENT-0027 and the protocol adoption as INTENT-0028 keeps the directive itself traceable. Interpretation drift risk: treating 'organize around' as license to merge or close others' PRs; this record expressly does neither.
roles.systems_architect: Canonical ownership follows docs/REPOSITORY_RATIONALIZATION_PLAN.md: kernel owns constitution, authority, shared contracts, event spine, evidence, consequence policy; DALEOBANKS owns public identity and publication operations; WMI owns venture evaluation. Duplication register DUP-1..DUP-5 names each parallel implementation with its canonical source. The WP line is unmerged and preserved; main is the merged, CI-verified, Claude-extended line and remains canonical. The organ-side stacks (DALEOBANKS #58-#61/#73, WMI #28) propose SDK-shim convergence while merged main carries vendored pinned schemas with parity tests; both are recorded, neither is disposed here.
roles.adversarial_reviewer: Strongest attack on this record: it is a model's map of other models' work and could entrench a Kimi-favorable reading. Mitigations: every load-bearing claim cites an inspectable artifact (SHA, PR number, path); claims not independently re-verified this session are labeled with their true evidence tier; authorship of the WP line is left unresolved rather than claimed. Second attack: issue #80 already did this; redoing it wastes founder attention. Counter: #80's artifacts were local-only and are lost; this record makes the trail durable and adds organ-side coverage #80 lacked. Third: the ownership map could ossify a premature canonical choice; each OWN record carries a review_trigger.
roles.operator_maintainer: Operational burden is one draft PR and one issue comment; zero runtime change, zero migration. Rollback is closing the PR. Handoff cost for the next agent drops: one document names canonical owners, duplications, and open founder decisions instead of reconstructing them from 30 PRs across three repositories.
roles.evidence_welfare_guardian: No external effects, no participant impact, no data subjects. Evidence discipline: survey claims are tier-marked; validator runs are recorded with exit codes; the WP line's external-consequence evidence (WP-03 live HTTPS capsule, WP-04 Neon rebuild drill) is acknowledged as stronger-tier than canonical main's in-memory equivalents without being promoted to commercial results. Negative evidence preserved: the lost 2026-08-21/22 local artifacts, the flagged direct-to-main organ pushes, CONTRADICTION-0001's 20 red tests on PR #71.

passes.summary: Intended outcome without assuming the mechanism: any qualified agent can identify canonical owners, duplications, and open founder decisions in under 30 minutes (rationalization success metric). Advantages compound: each future material PR cites the map instead of re-deriving it. Reversal condition: if the map becomes a second planning authority (cited as permission rather than orientation), it reverses into a liability; the record states it grants no authority.

disadvantages.text: A model-authored map of model work can entrench a self-favorable reading
disadvantages.handling: bounded: every load-bearing claim carries an inspectable reference; unverifiable authorship left unresolved

disadvantages.text: Partial overlap with issue #80's prose could fork the reconciliation narrative
disadvantages.handling: converted into a constraint: this record explicitly builds on #80, names what it regenerates, and cites #80 as source

disadvantages.text: Records without a founder ruling may read as decision pressure
disadvantages.handling: made observable: decision state is NEEDS_FOUNDER_DECISION for all convergence; the PR is a draft

disadvantages.text: Organ-side stacks (#58-#61/#73, #28) are mapped from PR metadata and issue #57/#27 records, not full code re-reads
disadvantages.handling: made observable: tier-marked as such; full code review assigned as next action to the convergence executor

passes.summary: Re-attacked as deployed. Bureaucracy: one PR, one comment, no recurring ceremony. Centralization: the map centralizes naming, not authority. Fragility: if main moves, OWN records carry review triggers. Gaming: a contributor could cite the map as endorsement; countered by the no-authority statement and draft status. Dependence on one model: the record is plain markdown/yaml/json, readable by any contributor.

dispositions.threshold: kill the record if any load-bearing claim fails inspection

dispositions.note: record states its lineage from issue #80 and regenerates the lost artifacts rather than restating them
draft PR + NEEDS_FOUNDER_DECISION on all convergence; record grants no authority

dispositions.threshold: before any convergence PR, re-read the full organ-side stack code; downgrade claims that fail

passes.residual_risk: The map is a snapshot of a fast-moving repository set; it ages. Review triggers are attached per OWN record.

dissent.strongest_objection: This reconciliation names canonical ownership while the founder has not ratified the ownership table itself beyond the rationalization plan's prose; a recorded recommendation can harden into perceived fact.
dissent.resolution_threshold: Founder ratifies or amends the ownership map (response to issue #80 or this PR); until then every OWN record is marked 'proposed, kernel rationalization plan lineage'.
dissent.review_trigger: founder response to issue #80 or this PR
